    Write example files in several on-disk formats

    Source: R/example-files.R
    cr_example_files.Rd

    Writes the tables behind cr_example_experiment() in the layouts the cr_read_* importers understand, so that the import functions can be demonstrated on real files without any being shipped.

    Usage

    cr_example_files(dir = tempdir(), seed = 42)

    Arguments

    dir

    Directory to write into. Created when it does not exist.

    seed

    Seed passed to cr_example_experiment().

    Value

    A character vector of the written file paths, invisibly.

    See also

    cr_example_exports() for a nested export tree with the design encoded in the paths, cr_example_path() for the files shipped inside the package.

    Other example data: cr_example_design(), cr_example_experiment(), cr_example_exports(), cr_example_path(), cr_example_screen()

    Examples

    d <- file.path(tempdir(), "cr_example_files")
files <- cr_example_files(d, seed = 1)
basename(files)
#> [1] "cells.csv"              "design.xlsx"            "cells_cellprofiler.csv"
#> [4] "cells_qupath.tsv"
